description: Defines the Borders class representing a collection of border objects used in document layout, including methods for cloning, serialization, and managing individual borders.

classes.name: Borders
classes.description: Represents a collection of border objects for document elements, providing accessors, cloning, and serialization functionalities.

classes.name: Borders.BordersValues
classes.description: Internal class holding nullable property values for Borders, including individual borders and style attributes.

methods.name: HasBorder
methods.description: Checks if a specific border type exists within the collection.

methods.name: GetBorder
methods.description: Retrieves the border object for a given border type.

methods.name: Clone
methods.description: Creates a deep copy of the Borders object.

methods.name: DeepCopy
methods.description: Performs the deep copy operation for the Borders object, cloning individual border properties.

methods.name: ClearAll
methods.description: Clears all border objects from the collection.

methods.name: Serialize
methods.description: Serializes the Borders object into DDL format.

methods.name: GetMyName
methods.description: Returns the name of a given border object.
